_README: Names for the one kind of Clause ref the extractor cannot derive: a rule stated on an
Ability's OPENING line rather than as a numbered item. The extractor emits those as `.pre`
and asks for a name; this file is the answer, so that the ref an audit issue carries is
reproducible from the Character Sheet rather than typed once into a GitHub issue.
A ref is how a finding cites a Clause — 46.4-AT cites `ME.lock` — so renaming one after
findings exist breaks the citation. They are named here, once, before the issues are opened.
Keyed by Character Sheet file basename, minus the `Copia de ` prefix and the `.md` suffix.
The vocabulary is deliberately small: `lock` a two-way switching lockout, `dur` a stated
duration, `scope` who an Ability reaches, `geom` a Noble Phantasm's area, `gate` a condition
on being used at all, `buffs` the named buffs an Ability applies.
